
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(kableExtra)
library(gplots)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}
# See barplots_dge_2025-07.qmd
seur_df <- readRDS("./lindsay/data/cell_metadata_2025-10-15.rds")

sample_metadata <-
	  unique(seur_df[,c("orig.ident", "time_point", "category",
			                        "batch", "trial", "individual")])

celltypes <- sort(unique((seur_df$kobe_idents)))
celltype_colors <- dittoSeq::dittoColors(1)[seq_along(celltypes)]
names(celltype_colors) <- celltypes

group_colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(4, "Paired")
names(group_colors) <-
	  c("Mild_Tox_Day28", "Mild_Tox_preA", "Severe_Tox_Day28",
	        "Severe_Tox_preA")
```

## Filtering

Kobe's filtering was slightly different from ours. Within Kobe's annotation, 93.9% of the cells were also in our object, and within our object, 97.7% of the cells were also in Kobe's object. The 250,117 cells overlapping between the two datasets were used in downstream analysis. Total cells per sample are listed in @tbl-cellcounts.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cellcounts
#| tbl-cap: "Cells per sample overlapping between Kobe's and Neerja's filtering."
seur_df %>%
	  filter(!is.na(kobe_idents)) %>%
	    group_by(orig.ident) %>%
	      summarize(count = n()) %>%
	        kable() %>% kable_styling()
```

```{r}
#| fig.width: 7
#| fig.height: 7
#| label: fig-umap_celltype
#| fig-cap: "UMAP after batch integration, colored by cell type"
centroids <- seur_df %>%
	  filter(!is.na(kobe_idents)) %>%
	    group_by(kobe_idents) %>%
	      summarize(umap_1 = median(umap_1), umap_2 = median(umap_2))

set.seed(701)
ord <- sample(which(!is.na(seur_df$kobe_idents)))

pdf("UMAP_paper_Jan29_kobe_celltypes.pdf")
ggplot(seur_df[ord,],
	            aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, mapping = aes(color = kobe_idents)) +
    geom_label_repel(data = centroids,
		                  mapping = aes(fill = kobe_idents, label = kobe_idents)) +
  annotate("label", x = c(9,9,3,9,9,9),
	              y = c(-10.5, -11.5, -11, -12.5, -13.5, -14.5),
		                 fill = celltype_colors[c(1:3, 5:6, 8)],
		                 label = celltypes[c(1:3, 5:6, 8)]) +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_colors, guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors, guide = "none") +
      labs(color = "Cell type") +

theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size=16),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16),        # Plot title
	axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),      # X-axis title
	axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),      # Y-axis title
	axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),       # Y-axis labels
	legend.title = element_text(size = 16),      # Legend title
	legend.text = element_text(size = 16))        # Legend text
dev.off()

```

## Cell type barplot

Loss of B and leukemia cells was observed with treatment (@fig-barplot).

```{r}
#| fig.width: 7
#| fig.height: 7
#| label: fig-barplot
#| fig-cap: "Proportion of each cell type within each sample."

patient_order <- c("PLAT05_S043", "PLAT02_S16", "PLAT02_S08",
		                      "PLAT05_S053", "PLAT05_S047", "PLAT02_S15",
				                         "PLAT05_S061", "PLAT05_S045","PLAT05_S041",
				                         "PLAT02_S13", "PLAT05_S040", "PLAT02_S12",
							                    "PLAT05_S066", "PLAT05_S055")
category_mod <- c(Non_responder = "NR", Mild_Tox = "Mild_Tox",
		                    Severe_Tox = "Severe_Tox",
				                      Non_responder_Severe_Tox = "NR")
pdf("Barplot_fig2_B.pdf", height=12, width = 12)
seur_df %>%
	  filter(!is.na(kobe_idents)) %>%
	    group_by(orig.ident, kobe_idents) %>%
	      summarize(n = n()) %>%
	        mutate(freq = n / sum(n)) %>%
		  left_join(sample_metadata, by = "orig.ident") %>%
		    mutate(label = factor(paste(trial, individual, sep = "_"),
			   levels = rev(patient_order)),
			   category2 = factor(category_mod[category],
			   levels = c("NR", "Mild_Tox","Severe_Tox"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = label,
	                  x = freq, fill = kobe_idents)) +
  geom_col() +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(category2), cols = vars(time_point),
	                    scales = "free", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors) +
    ylab("Sample") + xlab("Proportion") +
      labs(fill = "Cell type") +
theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size=16),
              plot.title = element_text(size = 16),        # Plot title
	              axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),      # X-axis title
	              axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),      # Y-axis title
		              axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),       # Y-axis labels
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),      # Legend title
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16), strip.text.x = element_text(size=16), strip.text.y = element_text(size=16))        # Legend text
dev.off()

```


## Generate UMAPs with new annotations from viewmastR and correct batch correction.
```{r}

seur <- readRDS(file = "./objects/PLAT_annotated_celltypes_cellbender_new_idents_chk_viewmastR.rds")

# Visualization
pdf("./plots/UMAP_fig_C.pdf")
DimPlot(seur, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("orig.ident"), label=T) + NoLegend() +
	theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16),        # Plot title
			                          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),      # X-axis title
			                          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),      # Y-axis title

						                                axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),       # Y-axis labels
						          legend.title = element_text(size = 16),      # Legend title
							          legend.text = element_text(size = 16))
dev.off()

						          legend.title = element_text(size = 16),      # Legend title
							          legend.text = element_text(size = 16))
dev.off()
